name: @w6w-apps/typefully
description: Write, schedule, and publish social media drafts across X, LinkedIn, Mastodon, Threads, Bluesky, and Substack Notes with Typefully.

w6w.longDescription:
Typefully is a writing and scheduling tool for social media, and this app covers its full Public API v2 surface: create, update, list, and delete drafts across X, LinkedIn, Mastodon, Threads, Bluesky, and Substack Notes; plan a draft's date without committing it to auto-publish, then confirm or schedule it later; reserve media uploads and poll their processing status; manage tags; read and replace a social set's recurring queue schedule and view its upcoming queue; resolve a LinkedIn company or school URL into ready-to-use @mention syntax; and read, create, resolve, update, and delete the comment threads collaborators leave on a draft.

Account-level visibility rounds it out: list every social set (account) an API key's user can reach, read a social set's configured platforms and publishing quota, and pull per-post or daily-follower analytics for X.

Health checks track the per-user request-rate headroom Typefully reports on every response; the vendor publishes no independent status feed, which this app states as a verified fact rather than leaving as a silent gap.
